episodes.title: She was CHOSEN... then put back 😱🥑 #shorts
episodes.logline: Naive tofu Tilly arrives in the fridge and learns its rules just as diva avocado Avery is picked by the Hand, squeezed, and humiliatingly put back.
episodes.hook_text: Welcome to the fridge. Everyone expires.
episodes.description: A soap opera inside your fridge. Episode 1 of Fridge Hearts.

shots.keyframe: blinding white light pouring into the fridge, the Hand lowering Tilly onto the middle shelf while all the groceries hold glamorous poses
shots.action: Tilly wobbles, looks around in wonder at everyone frozen in poses
shots.camera: wide from the back of the fridge toward the open door

lines.t: Ooh! Where am I? And why is everyone posing?

shots.keyframe: door closed, cool blue light, Avery gliding toward Tilly like a diva
shots.action: Avery flips her leafy hair and looks Tilly up and down

lines.t: Because, darling, when the Light comes... you pose. Or you rot.

shots.keyframe: Brock flexing his stalk, offering Tilly a handshake
shots.action: Brock flexes, Tilly shakes his little hand

lines.t: Welcome, new girl! Want some protein?
I AM protein.

shots.keyframe: Duchess Dijon on the door shelf like a throne, Rico leaning against a jar beside her
shots.action: Duchess adjusts her monocle, Rico tilts his cap
shots.camera: low angle on the door shelf

lines.t: Another newcomer. How quaint. Tell her the rules, Rico.
Rule one. Never trust the Light.

shots.keyframe: Milo trembling and sweating condensation next to Tilly
shots.action: Milo grabs Tilly by the shoulders

lines.t: Rule two: check your date! I have FOUR DAYS!
Is that... bad?

shots.keyframe: Tilly wandering into the dark corner, two narrow eyes opening on a foggy container lid
shots.action: Lenny's eyes glow, Tilly gulps and steps back

lines.t: Some who are Chosen never come back. Some come back... different.

shots.keyframe: the door flies open, white light floods in, Avery striking her best pose as the Hand reaches toward her
shots.action: the Hand closes around Avery and lifts her up into the light

lines.t: Finally. My moment.

shots.keyframe: the Hand placing Avery back on the shelf, door closing, Avery frozen in shock
shots.action: Avery stares into space; Tilly leans in

lines.t: He squeezed me. And put me BACK.
What does that mean?

episodes.loop_note: cliffhanger: what does being put back mean?

episodes.title: She ripened overnight... and regretted it 🥑🍌 #shorts
episodes.logline: Humiliated for being unripe, Avery spends a forbidden night in Banana Bianca's paper bag and wakes up gorgeous, with one tiny brown spot.
episodes.hook_text: She wasn't ripe enough. So she cheated.
episodes.description: Avery will do anything to be Chosen. Fridge Hearts, episode 2.

bianca.name: Banana Bianca
bianca.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic ripe yellow banana woman with a few freckle spots, lounging in a brown paper bag like a spa robe, cucumber slices on her eyes, small cartoon arms, glamorous older diva

shots.keyframe: Avery slumped dramatically against a jar, Brock beside her offering comfort
shots.action: Avery throws her arm over her face, Brock pats her back

lines.t: He put me back. Do you know what that means? I am NOT. RIPE.
Hey. Ripe is a journey.

shots.keyframe: Duchess sipping from a bottle cap like a teacup, Rico gazing down at the main shelf
shots.action: Duchess sips, Rico sighs

lines.t: Rejected by the Hand. In public. Delicious.
I would never reject her.

shots.keyframe: Tilly leaning in to Avery, Avery's eyes widening with an idea
shots.action: Avery grabs Tilly's arm

lines.t: Is there a way to ripen faster?
There is one way. Forbidden.

shots.keyframe: Banana Bianca lounging inside a paper bag in the misty crisper, Avery approaching
shots.action: Bianca lifts one cucumber slice off her eye

lines.t: One night in my bag, darling, and you'll wake up a whole new fruit.
Do it.

shots.keyframe: Avery stepping into the paper bag beside Bianca
shots.action: the paper bag begins to fold closed around them

lines.t: Fair warning. Ripening is irreversible.
I've waited my whole life.

shots.keyframe: night, the closed paper bag glowing warmly, Brock outside it looking worried
shots.action: Brock knocks on the bag

lines.t: Avery? You okay in there?
Never better!

shots.keyframe: morning light, Avery stepping onto the main shelf glowing, glossy and gorgeous, everyone gasping
shots.action: Avery poses as sparkles drift around her

lines.t: Behold. Peak. Ripeness.
Wow...

shots.keyframe: Tilly pointing at Avery's cheek, extreme close up on a tiny brown spot
shots.action: Avery slowly touches the spot, her face falling

lines.t: Avery... what's that?
No. No, no, no.

episodes.title: She made a deal with the Duchess 💛 #shorts
episodes.logline: Avery hides her brown spot with Duchess Dijon's mustard, but the favour comes with a debt the Duchess will one day collect.
episodes.description: Every jar on this door owes her something. Fridge Hearts, episode 3.

shots.keyframe: Avery hiding half her face behind a lettuce leaf, glaring at Tilly
shots.action: Avery pulls Tilly close

lines.t: Nobody sees this spot. Nobody. Tilly, you saw nothing.
Saw what?

shots.keyframe: Avery climbing onto the golden door shelf, Duchess waiting regally
shots.action: Avery bows her head, Duchess's monocle glints

lines.t: Duchess. I need your... mustard.
My mustard isn't for sale, darling. It's for favours.

shots.keyframe: Duchess dabbing a dot of golden mustard onto Avery's brown spot like concealer
shots.action: the spot disappears under a golden glow

lines.t: There. Flawless.
It stings.
Beauty does.

shots.keyframe: Brock gazing at a glowing Avery, then sniffing the air
shots.action: Brock leans closer and sniffs

lines.t: You look amazing. Do you smell... tangy?
It's a new perfume.

shots.keyframe: Rico sliding down from the door shelf to Avery's side
shots.action: Rico circles her slowly

lines.t: Funny. Your glow smells like the Door Shelf. Like... aristocracy.
Mind your own bottle, Rico.

shots.keyframe: Tilly crouched beside Lenny in the shadows
shots.action: Lenny's eyes narrow

lines.t: Avery made a deal with the Duchess.
Then she belongs to the Door now.

shots.keyframe: Avery returning to the door shelf, Duchess not looking up
shots.action: Duchess slowly turns her jar to face Avery

lines.t: What do I owe you?
Nothing, darling. Yet.

shots.keyframe: extreme close up on Duchess's monocle reflecting Avery
shots.action: Duchess smiles slowly

lines.t: Every jar on this door owes me something. Now, so do you.

episodes.title: His expiry date came... and he SURVIVED 🥛 #shorts
episodes.logline: Anxious milk carton Milo throws his own farewell party on his last day, gets sniffed by the Hand, and is put back, convincing himself he's immortal.
episodes.hook_text: Last day before his expiry date 🥛
episodes.description: Milo doesn't have long. Or does he? Fridge Hearts, episode 4.

shots.keyframe: Milo pacing the shelf, sweating condensation, Tilly watching
shots.action: Milo grabs his own spout in panic

lines.t: It's my last day! I'm in my final chapter!
What happens after?

shots.keyframe: Milo dictating to Tilly, who writes with a crumb on a napkin
shots.action: Milo gestures grandly

lines.t: My cold spot goes to Brock. My lid... to science.

shots.keyframe: a farewell party in the butter compartment, tiny party hats, string of bottle caps as bunting
shots.action: Brock lifts Milo onto a butter dish stage

lines.t: Speech! Speech!
You were all... mostly fine. I'll miss the hum.

shots.keyframe: Duchess raising a bottle cap like a champagne glass
shots.action: everyone raises their caps

lines.t: To Milo. Gone too soon. Well... exactly on schedule.

shots.keyframe: the door bursts open, light floods in, the Hand grabbing Milo
shots.action: Milo is lifted up into the blinding light, flailing

lines.t: This is it! Tell my story! Make it dramatic!

shots.keyframe: Milo tilted sideways in the Hand in the bright light
shots.action: a loud sniffing sound; Milo shrinks in fear

lines.t: Is he... smelling me?

shots.keyframe: Milo placed back on the shelf, door closing, Tilly rushing to him
shots.action: Tilly hugs Milo, who stares blankly

lines.t: You came back!
He smelled me. And put me back.

shots.keyframe: Milo slowly rising tall, dramatic backlight behind him
shots.action: Milo raises his arms like a god

lines.t: Past my date. Still good. Do you know what this means? I'm... IMMORTAL.

episodes.title: His REPLACEMENT just arrived 🥛😳 #shorts
episodes.logline: Milo brags that he's beaten expiry forever until a brand-new milk carton, Fresh Freddie, is placed right beside him.
episodes.hook_text: He thought he was immortal. Then HE arrived.
episodes.description: Every milk gets replaced eventually. Fridge Hearts, episode 5.

shots.keyframe: Milo wearing tiny sunglasses, leaning back like royalty
shots.action: Milo waves dismissively at Brock

lines.t: Bow down. I've cheated death. Expiry dates are for the weak.
Bro, that's not how dates work.

shots.keyframe: Milo smirking at Avery, who is fixing her leafy hair
shots.action: Avery freezes mid-preen

lines.t: Avery, I'll still be here when you're guacamole.
How DARE you.

shots.keyframe: Lenny's glowing eyes in the dark, Milo standing confidently in front of him
shots.action: Lenny leans forward out of the shadow

lines.t: No one is immortal, Milo. Not even the ketchup.
Spooky. Love it. Still immortal.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, light floods in, the Hand placing a shiny new milk carton on the shelf
shots.action: Freddie lands, beaming and waving

lines.t: Hi, everyone! Fresh as ever!

shots.keyframe: Freddie right next to Milo; Milo's sunglasses sliding down his face
shots.action: Freddie offers a handshake, Milo stares

lines.t: Same brand, same shelf! I'm Freddie. Use-by: next MONTH!

shots.keyframe: Avery leaning in with a cruel smile
shots.action: Avery pats Milo on the head

lines.t: Oh, Milo. You're not immortal. You're the backup.

shots.keyframe: extreme close up of Milo's trembling eyes
shots.action: a single condensation drop rolls down his carton

lines.t: The backup? I'm... the backup?

shots.keyframe: Freddie cheerfully putting an arm around Milo
shots.action: Milo faints backward onto the shelf

lines.t: Don't worry, buddy! The Hand always picks the freshest one first!

episodes.title: He came back HALF EMPTY 🥛💔 #shorts
episodes.logline: Milo bullies his replacement Freddie until the Hand takes Freddie, who returns half-empty with terrifying news about the world outside.
episodes.hook_text: There can only be one milk.
episodes.description: Freddie has seen the outside world. Fridge Hearts, episode 6.

shots.keyframe: Milo and Freddie facing each other like rival cowboys
shots.action: Milo steps forward menacingly

lines.t: There can only be one milk on this shelf.
Why? There's loads of room!

shots.keyframe: Milo pushing Freddie toward the back of the shelf, Tilly gasping
shots.action: Freddie slides behind a jar

lines.t: Milo! That's so mean!
It's survival, Tilly. It's a milk-eat-milk world.

shots.keyframe: light floods in, the Hand reaching past Milo to grab Freddie from the back
shots.action: Freddie waves as he is lifted away

lines.t: Ooh! Me? Bye, everyone!

shots.keyframe: Milo alone on the empty spot in blue light
shots.action: Milo looks at the empty space where Freddie was

lines.t: I won. So why do I feel... sour?

shots.keyframe: Brock sitting down beside Milo
shots.action: Brock puts an arm around him

lines.t: He was a good carton, bro.
He was annoying. And bright. And I never said goodbye.

shots.keyframe: the door opens again, the Hand placing Freddie back, now visibly half-empty and wobbly
shots.action: Freddie sways, eyes wide and haunted

lines.t: I'm back. Well... half of me.

shots.keyframe: Milo rushing to Freddie, holding him steady
shots.action: Freddie stares into the distance

lines.t: What's it like out there?
It's warm. It's loud. There's cereal everywhere.

shots.keyframe: Freddie leaning in to whisper to Milo
shots.action: Milo's eyes go huge

lines.t: And Milo... there's a cat.

episodes.title: What's inside the mystery container? 🫙 #shorts
episodes.logline: The fridge argues over what's inside mysterious leftover Lenny until Tilly peeks and returns tinted green with a disturbing answer.
episodes.description: Some leftovers should stay mysteries. Fridge Hearts, episode 7.

shots.keyframe: Tilly looking toward the dark corner, Avery filing her nails on a crumb
shots.action: Avery stops filing and lowers her voice

lines.t: What's inside Lenny?
Nobody knows. Nobody has EVER known.

shots.keyframe: Brock and Milo leaning together conspiratorially
shots.action: they trade theories, getting more animated

lines.t: I heard he's lasagne.
I heard he's a soup that became self-aware.

shots.keyframe: Duchess and Rico on the door shelf looking down into the shadows
shots.action: Rico lowers his cap

lines.t: He was here before me. And I arrived in 2019.
Some say he IS the fridge.

shots.keyframe: Tilly tiptoeing up to Lenny in the flickering dark
shots.action: Lenny's eyes slowly open

lines.t: Lenny? Can I... peek?
Many have asked. None have recovered.

shots.keyframe: Lenny lifting the corner of his lid, an eerie green glow lighting Tilly's face
shots.action: green mist curls out and touches Tilly

lines.t: Ooh! What's that smell?

shots.keyframe: Tilly turning pale green from absorbing the smell, swaying
shots.action: she hiccups a tiny green bubble

lines.t: I feel... ancient.

shots.keyframe: green-tinted Tilly returning to the main shelf, everyone crowding around
shots.action: Avery grabs Tilly by the shoulders

lines.t: Well? WHAT IS HE?
It's... soup.

shots.keyframe: Lenny alone in the shadows, eyes glowing
shots.action: his lid slowly settles shut

lines.t: It WAS soup. Now... it's something else.

episodes.loop_note: cliffhanger: what has the soup become?

episodes.title: He trained all day to be picked... 🥦❄️ #shorts
episodes.logline: Gym-bro broccoli Brock trains all day to be chosen for dinner, loses out to a frozen pizza, and is accidentally shoved into the freezer.
episodes.hook_text: He trained his WHOLE life for this moment 🥦
episodes.description: Brock wanted to be Chosen. He got exiled. Fridge Hearts, episode 8.

shots.keyframe: Brock doing one-armed push-ups in the misty crisper
shots.action: he finishes a rep and stands, determined

lines.t: Tonight's dinner: steamed greens. The Hand WILL choose me.

shots.keyframe: Brock steaming himself in a bottle-cap sauna, Tilly watching
shots.action: training montage: steam, flexing, stretching

lines.t: Why do you want to be Chosen so badly?
Glory. Purpose. A plate.

shots.keyframe: Avery holding Brock's little hand
shots.action: they look into each other's eyes

lines.t: And if you don't come back?
Then I'll go out green.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, light floods in, Brock posing heroically on the shelf edge
shots.action: the Hand reaches toward Brock, then swerves up and out of frame toward the freezer

lines.t: Here I am! Fully fibrous! Pick me!

shots.keyframe: Brock deflated, watching a frozen pizza box pass by in the Hand
shots.action: Brock's florets droop

lines.t: A frozen pizza. From the NORTH.
Ouch. Processed.

shots.keyframe: the Hand sweeping items aside to make space, scooping Brock up
shots.action: the Hand lifts Brock upward toward the freezer door

lines.t: Wait! Wrong way! WRONG WAY!

shots.keyframe: Avery running to the shelf edge reaching up, Tilly beside her
shots.action: Avery reaches toward the ceiling as frost drifts down

lines.t: BROCK!
Where did he go?
The North.

shots.keyframe: Brock alone in the icy freezer, frost creeping over his florets, two cold glowing eyes in the darkness behind him
shots.action: Brock turns slowly as the eyes open

lines.t: Hello? Is anyone... out there?

episodes.title: Exiled to the freezer ❄️👑 #shorts
episodes.logline: In the frozen North, Brock meets Queen Pea, the icy ruler of the freezer, who decides he may be useful to her plans.
episodes.description: Welcome to the North. Fridge Hearts, episode 9.

shots.keyframe: Brock shivering among frozen bags like snowy mountains, his florets frosted
shots.action: Brock hugs himself, breath visible

lines.t: So cold. Can't feel my florets.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea rising on a throne of ice cubes, frost crown glittering
shots.action: frozen peas roll aside like courtiers bowing

lines.t: A fresh vegetable. In MY kingdom.
Your... kingdom?

shots.keyframe: close on Queen Pea's frosty face
shots.action: frost spreads across the ground from her throne

lines.t: I am Queen Pea. Ruler of the North. Frozen since the Before Times.

shots.keyframe: Brock stepping toward the throne bravely
shots.action: Queen Pea laughs coldly

lines.t: I need to get back. Someone's waiting for me.
Everyone has someone. Nobody leaves the North.

shots.keyframe: Avery pacing the main shelf, Rico leaning nearby
shots.action: Avery stops and stares upward at the freezer

lines.t: Forget him, Avery. The North changes a vegetable.
Then I'll wait for whoever comes back.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea circling Brock
shots.action: Brock flexes through the shivers

lines.t: You have warmth in you. How... irritating.
Stay green. Stay mean.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea leaning close to Brock, a thin smile
shots.action: she taps his frosty floret

lines.t: Interesting. You may be useful to me.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea turning directly toward the camera, eyes glowing icy blue
shots.action: frost creeps over the lens

lines.t: Nobody leaves the North... unthawed.

episodes.title: He came back from the freezer CHANGED 🥦🧊 #shorts
episodes.logline: Brock returns frozen from the North, wins Avery's heart with his loyalty, but reveals he was released as Queen Pea's messenger.
episodes.hook_text: He came back from the freezer... different.
episodes.description: Brock is back. So is a warning. Fridge Hearts, episode 10.

shots.keyframe: the Hand placing a frost-covered Brock back on the main shelf, frozen stiff in a heroic pose
shots.action: frost mist rolls off Brock, Tilly rushes over

lines.t: It's Brock! He's back!

shots.keyframe: Avery hugging the frozen Brock
shots.action: Brock's eyes slowly move

lines.t: Say something!
C... c... cold.

shots.keyframe: Brock thawing, droplets running down his florets, haunted eyes
shots.action: Brock stares into the distance

lines.t: I've seen things, Avery. Peas. Thousands of peas. And a queen.

shots.keyframe: Rico glaring down from the door shelf, Duchess fanning herself
shots.action: Rico crosses his arms

lines.t: Look at him. Dripping for attention.
Jealousy is so spicy on you, darling.

shots.keyframe: Milo leaning in nervously, Brock wrapped in a paper napkin like a blanket
shots.action: Brock looks toward Avery

lines.t: Was it scary?
She offered me a crown of frost. I said no. For Avery.

shots.keyframe: Avery touching Brock's cheek
shots.action: they lean their foreheads together

lines.t: For me?
Always.

shots.keyframe: Rico arriving behind them, leaning on a jar
shots.action: Avery turns sharply

lines.t: How touching. And how... convenient.

shots.keyframe: Brock suddenly serious, frost reflected in his eyes
shots.action: Brock grips Avery's hand tightly

lines.t: I wasn't released, Avery. I was sent. Queen Pea is coming.

episodes.title: The ketchup wants the CROWN 🍅👑 #shorts
episodes.logline: Loud ketchup bottle Kev challenges Duchess Dijon for control of the Door Shelf, and the election ends in a tie that only Tilly can break.
episodes.description: Election day on the Door Shelf. Fridge Hearts, episode 11.

shots.keyframe: Kev Ketchup slamming down onto the door shelf, waving his arms
shots.action: Duchess's monocle pops out

lines.t: Ketchup for the people! This door needs a NEW leader!
Who let the ketchup in?

shots.keyframe: Kev on top of a bottle cap podium rallying cheering condiment jars
shots.action: Kev pumps his fist, jars cheer

lines.t: Equal shelf space! Free lids for all! No more mustard monarchy!

shots.keyframe: Duchess turning to Rico for support
shots.action: Rico avoids her eyes

lines.t: Rico. Rally the jars.
Sorry, Duchess. I'm... undecided.

shots.keyframe: Brock and Avery watching the rally from below
shots.action: Avery touches her mustard-concealed spot nervously

lines.t: Kev's got good slogans.
Slogans aren't a plan. And the Duchess knows my secret.

shots.keyframe: Kev and Duchess on opposite bottle cap podiums like a debate
shots.action: they lean toward each other

lines.t: What's YOUR plan, Duchess?
Continuity, darling. I've survived nine Clean-Outs.

shots.keyframe: Milo counting votes made of peppercorns into two piles
shots.action: Milo places the last peppercorn and gasps

lines.t: Kev, six. Duchess, six. It's a TIE!

shots.keyframe: everyone slowly turning to look at Tilly
shots.action: Tilly shrinks under all the stares

lines.t: Tilly hasn't voted.
Me? I don't know anything about politics!

shots.keyframe: the shadows of Kev and Duchess falling across Tilly
shots.action: Tilly gulps

lines.t: Can I... sleep on it?

episodes.title: The Duchess's DARKEST secret 💛😱 #shorts
episodes.logline: Tilly absorbs every candidate's flavour and keeps changing her mind, votes for herself, and forces Duchess to confess she has been expired since 2019.
episodes.description: The vote. The confession. Fridge Hearts, episode 12.

shots.keyframe: Kev giving Tilly a ketchup spa treatment, Tilly turning red
shots.action: Tilly's colour shifts from white to red

lines.t: Kev makes so much sense!
Ketchup for the people!

shots.keyframe: Duchess dabbing Tilly with mustard, Tilly turning yellow
shots.action: Tilly's colour shifts to golden yellow

lines.t: The Duchess is so... wise!

shots.keyframe: Brock steaming Tilly in the crisper sauna, Tilly turning green
shots.action: Tilly does a squat beside Brock

lines.t: Maybe we should all just... exercise?
Now you're talking!

shots.keyframe: rainbow-streaked Tilly with Avery shaking her
shots.action: Tilly's colours flicker

lines.t: Stop absorbing everyone! What do YOU think?
I don't know! I'm tofu!

shots.keyframe: Tilly, back to plain white, standing at a bottle cap ballot box
shots.action: she drops in her peppercorn vote

lines.t: I vote... for me.
You can't vote for YOURSELF!

shots.keyframe: Rico slowly clapping
shots.action: Rico tips his cap to Tilly

lines.t: Bold. Rebellious. I'm switching my vote to Tilly.

shots.keyframe: Duchess rising, cornered, the jars falling silent
shots.action: Duchess raises a hand for silence

lines.t: Enough! You want the truth? Here it is.
Oh, here we go.

shots.keyframe: Duchess slowly turning her jar to reveal a faded old date stamp on her back
shots.action: everyone gasps; Duchess holds her chin high

lines.t: I expired in 2019. I've been expired for years... and nobody noticed.

episodes.title: The ancient pickle knows EVERYTHING 🥒 #shorts
episodes.logline: Desperate to stop browning, Avery journeys into the Dark Corner to consult Old Pickle, who offers a costly cure and hints at the Duchess's lost love.
episodes.hook_text: She went where no one goes: the Dark Corner.
episodes.description: Avery seeks a cure. Fridge Hearts, episode 13.

old_pickle.name: Old Pickle
old_pickle.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic very old wrinkled green pickle in a cloudy glass jar, long beard made of dill fronds, squinting wise eyes, small cartoon arms, hermit sage

shots.keyframe: Avery staring at her reflection in a spoon, mustard flaking off her brown spot
shots.action: a flake of mustard falls away
shots.camera: close up through the spoon reflection

lines.t: The mustard's wearing off. I need a real cure.

shots.keyframe: Tilly whispering to Avery, both looking toward the shadowy back of the fridge
shots.action: Avery stands up resolutely

lines.t: Lenny says someone in the Dark Corner knows everything.
Then that's where I'm going.

shots.keyframe: Avery and Tilly creeping through the flickering shadows past forgotten jars
shots.action: the light flickers, they cling to each other

lines.t: It smells like... history.

shots.keyframe: Old Pickle emerging from a cloudy jar, dill beard swaying
shots.action: Old Pickle squints at them

lines.t: Visitors. Haven't had those since the fridge magnet fell.

shots.keyframe: Avery kneeling before the Old Pickle's jar
shots.action: Old Pickle chuckles

lines.t: I need to stop browning. Forever.
Easy. Brine. Sixty years in a jar.

shots.keyframe: Avery recoiling, Old Pickle raising a bony finger
shots.action: Old Pickle leans closer

lines.t: I am NOT becoming a pickle.
Then there's lime. But lime comes at a cost.

shots.keyframe: Old Pickle squinting at Tilly with a knowing smile
shots.action: Tilly leans in

lines.t: You live near the Duchess? Ha. She wasn't always alone up there.
What do you mean?

shots.keyframe: extreme close up on Old Pickle's eye through the cloudy glass
shots.action: the light flickers out

lines.t: Ask her... about Lady Mayo.

episodes.title: The love the Duchess lost 💔 #shorts
episodes.logline: The Duchess finally tells the tragic story of Lady Mayo, her partner who was Chosen in 2019 and never returned, just as Lenny unearths Mayo's lost lid.
episodes.hook_text: Her heartbreak has a name: Lady Mayo.
episodes.description: The Duchess's past. Fridge Hearts, episode 14.

lady_mayo.name: Lady Mayo
lady_mayo.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic elegant glass jar of creamy white mayonnaise, white lid with a pearl ribbon tied in a bow, gentle warm eyes, plain label with no text, small cartoon arms, graceful lady

shots.keyframe: Avery facing Duchess on the door shelf
shots.action: Duchess's monocle drops and dangles

lines.t: Duchess. Who is Lady Mayo?

shots.keyframe: Duchess looking away, the light softening
shots.action: the frame slowly fades to sepia

lines.t: Sit, darling. It was 2019. The fridge was new. And so was I.

shots.keyframe: sepia flashback: a younger, shinier Duchess laughing beside Lady Mayo on the door shelf
shots.action: they lean their lids together

lines.t: Darling, we'll rule this door together. Forever.
Forever.

shots.keyframe: sepia: light flooding in, the Hand lifting Lady Mayo away
shots.action: Lady Mayo waves back toward the door shelf

lines.t: I'll come back, darling. I promise.

shots.keyframe: back to present colour, Duchess beside an empty circular spot on the shelf
shots.action: Duchess touches the empty space

lines.t: She never came back. I've kept her spot empty for seven years.
That's why you never leave.

shots.keyframe: Avery resting her hand on Duchess's lid
shots.action: Duchess sniffs and straightens up

lines.t: I'm so sorry.
Don't be. Pity browns you faster.

shots.keyframe: Lenny dragging something out from deep shadows, Tilly watching
shots.action: Lenny pulls an object into the light

lines.t: Lenny, what's that?

shots.keyframe: Lenny holding up an old white jar lid tied with a faded pearl ribbon
shots.action: the ribbon sways in the light

lines.t: Found this... in the back. It belonged to a Lady.

episodes.title: A love triangle in the crisper drawer 🥦🥑🌶️ #shorts
episodes.logline: Brock takes Avery on a romantic date in the crisper while the gossiping Lemon Twins spot jealous Rico watching, and Rico declares war.
episodes.description: Love is in the crisper. So is war. Fridge Hearts, episode 15.

lemon_lou.name: Lemon Lou
lemon_lou.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman, gossipy wide eyes, tiny green leaf on top like a bow, small cartoon arms, leaning conspiratorially

lemon_lu.name: Lemon Lu

shots.keyframe: the crisper decorated with sparkling condensation like fairy lights, Brock presenting it to Avery
shots.action: Avery gasps, hands to her face

lines.t: I booked the crisper. Just us.
Brock... it's beautiful.

shots.keyframe: Avery and Brock lounging in the mist side by side
shots.action: Avery turns to Brock

lines.t: Do you ever worry about being Chosen?
Only if I'm Chosen without you.

shots.keyframe: the Lemon Twins peeking over a lettuce leaf
shots.action: they grip each other excitedly

lines.t: Are you seeing this?
Seeing it AND squeezing it!

shots.keyframe: Avery resting her head on Brock's shoulder
shots.action: Brock gently tucks a leaf behind her ear

lines.t: When I'm with you, I forget about the brown.
What brown? You're perfect.

shots.keyframe: Rico watching through a gap in the shelf, trembling with emotion
shots.action: Rico clutches a scrap of napkin covered in scribbles

lines.t: Perfect? I wrote her forty poems.

shots.keyframe: the Lemon Twins spinning around to spot Rico in the distance
shots.action: they gasp in unison

lines.t: Rico's watching!
Love triangle! Zesty!

shots.keyframe: Duchess appearing beside Rico on the door shelf
shots.action: Rico turns away from her

lines.t: Let it go, Rico. Bitterness doesn't suit a sauce.
I'm not bitter. I'm HOT.

shots.keyframe: Rico twisting his cap tight, eyes burning red
shots.action: steam rises from his bottle

lines.t: If the broccoli wants a war... he's got one.
